description: This is a unit test class for the BasketWithItemsSpecification in the eShopWeb application. It contains tests verifying that the specification correctly matches baskets based on basket ID and buyer ID.

classes.name: BasketWithItems
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for the BasketWithItemsSpecification in the eShopWeb application.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBasketId
methods.description: Tests if the specification correctly matches a basket with a specific basket ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBasketIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests if the specification correctly returns no matches when a non-existent basket ID is used.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBuyerId
methods.description: Tests if the specification correctly matches a basket with a specific buyer ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBuyerIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests if the specification correctly returns no matches when a non-existent buyer ID is used.

methods.name: GetTestBasketCollection
methods.description: Creates and returns a test collection of basket mocks for unit testing.
